cohort: 115 patients with secondary infertility of more than one year who had previous one or more spontaneous conceptions
finding: The study identified several risk factors for secondary infertility, including history of miscarriage, sex of previous children, and mode of previous deliveries.
mod_finding: Among 61 women with previous live births, 43 had vaginal deliveries (33 normal, 10 instrumental) and 18 had cesarean sections (13 emergency, 5 elective).
